Libraries that ship inside the program (nothing is loaded from the internet except the Google sign-in script):
- xlsx.full.min.js: SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0), reads and writes Excel files in the browser.
- fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2: Inter, @fontsource-variable/inter 5.3.0 (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
- fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-wght-normal.woff2: JetBrains Mono, @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0 (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
